{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:DybbukConvict-LostFound.png]] |name=Melo Tolicus |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]]{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|She helped me, and I betrayed her and took the last escape pod.|Melo Tolicus to Sol, regarding Verosha Aniseya|}} '''Melo Tolicus''' was a [[human]] [[miner]] who lived during the [[High Republic Era]]. After suffering [[space psychosis]], he [[Death|killed]] several fellow miners and was taken [[prisoner]]. In [[132 BBY]], Tolicus was transported in a cell aboard the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship|prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'' while restrained by a [[dybbuk]], a [[Parasite|parasitic]] organism that subdued the convict. He was eventually released by the [[meknek]] [[Verosha Aniseya]] during an escape attempt by other convicts, but betrayed her and left in an [[escape pod]] without her. He was later imprisoned on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], where [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]] interrogated him for Aniseya's whereabouts. ==Biography== ===Subdued on a prison ship=== {{Quote|Dybbuk.''"
"''Excuse me?''"
"''It's a parasite used to subdue violent criminals.''"
"''Oh…Is it hurting him?''"
"''No way, he's having a great time.|Syreth Dunn and Verosha Aniseya|}} [[File:Dybbuk-Databank.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Melo Tolicus was restrained by a dybbuk.]] Melo Tolicus was a [[human]] who worked as a [[miner]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. By [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} while working at a valuable deep [[Realspace|space]] [[Mining|mine]], Tolicus succumbed to [[space psychosis]] as a result of the profound isolation and pressures he experienced and [[Death|killed]] several fellow miners. After, Tolicus was taken [[prisoner]]. In 132 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Tolicus was transported in a cell aboard the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship|prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'' alongside other [[Corporate Sector]] criminals to be processed by the [[Detention Task Force]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. While aboard the ''Palwick'', special measures were used to keep Tolicus restrained and prevent him from revealing the location of the mine, including a [[Parasite|parasitic]] [[dybbuk]] that latched onto his mouth and induced an altered state of consciousness.{{Databank|dybbuk|Dybbuk}} As the ''Palwick'' traveled through [[hyperspace]], Tolicus groaned while laying barely conscious{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}} on the floor of his cell. The [[meknek]] [[Verosha Aniseya]], who was being held in the cell next to Tolicus, observed him, and the prisoner [[Syreth Dunn]], who was held across from Aniseya, informed her of the dybbuk's purpose. Aniseya inquired if the dybbuk was hurting Tolicus, and Dunn responded that he was having a great time. Dunn and his fellow prisoners then asked Aniseya if she had truly killed a [[Jedi]] and told her of their escape plan, inviting her to join them, though she declined. ===Betraying Aniseya=== {{Quote|The Jedi-killer is evil! I sensed her darkness.|Melo Tolicus to Sol, on Verosha Aniseya|}} [[File:SolMeloTolicus-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|Melo Tolicus is mind tricked by Sol.]] Soon after, the other prisoners began their escape, exploiting a security flaw to cause the ''Palwick'' to drop from hyperspace and then using a [[droid]] [[Limb|arm]] to open their cell. The group entered an [[escape pod]], leaving Tolicus and Aniseya behind. Aniseya was able to escape her cell using her [[PIP droid]] [[Pip]] and rushed to another escape pod, but then stopped and turned back to Tolicus's cell. She attempted to lift him, but was unable, and so used Pip to shock the dybbuk restraining him, causing it to release its grip. Disoriented, Tolicus began shouting and grasping at the wall of his cell. He then stood and shoved Aniseya aside as he ran to the escape pod, which he ejected before she could join him aboard it. The ''Palwick'', which had collided with several [[asteroid]]s, then crashed on the planet [[Carlac]]. Tolicus and the other prisoners were later recaptured and kept in holding cells in Coruscant's [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]]. In his cell, Tolicus sat while fidgeting and grabbing at his head. As [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]], who was searching for Aniseya, walked toward Tolicus's cell to question him, the prisoner stood and claimed that the Jedi-killer was evil and that he had sensed her darkness. Sol then entered the cell, and after using a [[mind trick]] on Tolicus, the prisoner admitted that Aniseya had actually helped him and he had betrayed her. When Sol left the cell, Tolicus returned to sitting in its corner. Aniseya was later found on Carlac and cleared of her crime. ==Personality and traits== Melo Tolicus had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and light skin. He was a violent criminal who required a dybbuk to restrain him. Although Verosha Aniseya helped him, he betrayed her and claimed that she was evil when asked about her. ==Equipment== Tolicus wore a tattered brown [[Clothing|shawl]] made of [[graphin]] hide and an improvised [[sash]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:DybbukConvictCostumeConcept-ArtOfAcolyte.png|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Eleanor Barlow with costume design by Jennifer Bryan]] Melo Tolicus first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which was released on [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]],{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} and was portrayed by [[Dan Milne]]. Prior to the episode's release, he was first depicted in a trailer uploaded to the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[March 19]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} Tolicus was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The scenes aboard the ''Palwick''{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} including Tolicus were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]] in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]]. The scene at the Jedi Temple's holding cell was shot on Stage 17 of Shinfield Studios on [[November 7]], [[2022]]. Tolicus's costume was designed by [[Jennifer Bryan]], and costume concept art of him was created by [[Eleanor Barlow]].''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' ==Appearances== *{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{1st}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Melo Tolicus}} *{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} {{1stm}} *{{YouTube|channel=@StarWarsAUNZ|name=''Star Wars'' Australia & New Zealand|video=ksgTjH1JoHk|text=Lee Jung-jae | The Acolyte}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|RXF0IfbgpXQ|The Acolyte | Exploring Star Wars | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|9DItelHk3ng|The Acolyte Launch Event Recap}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|DmI8K7Cz0jg|The Characters of The Acolyte | Now Streaming on Disney+}} {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Melo Tolicus}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' *{{Databank|dybbuk|Dybbuk}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Melo Tolicus |fr=Melo Tolicus |ka=მელო ტოლიკუსი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Tolicus, Melo}} [[Category:Criminals]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Miners]]
